Hello, I love your art and the amount of detail you put into dresses!

Can you draw VTuber Iekushi Chapipi?

Chapipi is a computer virus and a bit of a brat, but also gets flustered and embarrassed easily! She can also sing very well. She's very talented and tries to provide a lot of variety! This includes being cute sometimes, cool other times, and seductive when she wants to be.

Can you draw Chapipi being princess carried in a pose like the one referenced below? Feel free to design a princess dress for Chapipi, but do not include the injuries from the pose reference! The man should be wearing a light blue dress shirt.

Thank you!
